title: Modula gallery settings – grouped & typed (target for adapter)
description: Target grouped structure. Adapter maps flat modula-settings → these groups; canonical post meta for JSON is modula_settings_v2.

gridType.description: Column count for grid, uniform-grid, fit-grid, and parallax-masonry. Legacy “automatic” is represented as gallery type justified-grid, not stored here.

uniformGridTileAspect.description: Shape of each equal-cell grid tile; images fill the tile (uniform grid crops; fit grid shows the full photo).

uniformGridTileAspectCustom.description: Width:height for CSS aspect-ratio; each part is clamped 1–20 (e.g. 16 and 9 → 16:9).

fitGridImageAlign.description: Where each photo sits inside its fit-grid tile.

gridImageSize.description: Registered WP image size slug (or custom/default). Options come from PHP wp_localize_script.

gridImageDimensions.description: Used when gridImageSize is custom (or default in some layouts): exact width/height for srcset/thumbs.

imgSize.description: Legacy thumbnail tile edge (px) for custom-grid when gridImageSize is custom; not used by v2 React layout.

imgCrop.description: Legacy hard-crop flag for custom-grid thumbnails; not used by v2 React layout.

gridImageCrop.description: Crop when using a registered size vs custom gridImageSize + gridImageDimensions (see classic Gallery Images Size flow).

lightbox.description: Further lightbox options apply when click behavior opens the lightbox.

doubleClick.description: On desktop, use a double-click to open the lightbox; on phones and tablets, use a double-tap. Helps prevent accidental opens.

captionPosition.description: Applies when the lightbox shows the title, the caption, or both.

wheel.description: Scroll wheel moves to the previous or next image while the lightbox is open (legacy mousewheel navigation).

clickSlide.description: Closes the lightbox when clicking the image or the dark area around it. When off, clicking the image zooms instead.

touch.description: Swipe and pinch-zoom on the lightbox image (Fancybox Panzoom). Always enabled in v2; not exposed in the settings UI.

showThumbnails.description: Show the thumbnail strip when the lightbox opens (legacy key: thumbsAutoStart).

thumbsPosition.description: Thumbnail strip position when thumbnails are visible.

mobileCaptionCopy.description: When the lightbox shows the image caption, visitors on phones and tablets can copy it with a double-tap.

builder.description: Composable hover: card treatment and per-slot entrance animations. Use the Hover section preview and inspector.

sourcePresetId.description: Last applied hover preset id (for “— customized” labels when builder no longer matches exactly).

slotPositions.description: Per-slot anchor on the image (percent of media box, 0–100).

modulaSpeedHelp.description: Placeholder key; UI shows help text only in editor.

enableResponsive.description: Different column counts on smaller screens for grids, or slide counts for sliders.

imageSize.description: WordPress size used for the slide image file (quality). The slider still spans the gallery width — pick Large or Full for full-width carousels. Thumbnail is only suitable for small previews; Custom sets a display box below.

imageDimensions.description: Used when Slider image size is Custom. “Crop to dimensions” controls hard crop vs preserving aspect ratio.

imageCrop.description: When on, images are cropped to the exact width and height. When off, proportions are preserved within that box.

syncingNavSize.description: Size of thumbnails in the strip. Choose Custom to set width and height below.

syncingNavImageDimensions.description: Used when Thumbnail image size is Custom. “Crop to dimensions” applies to the thumbnail strip.

syncingNavImageCrop.description: When on, thumbnails are cropped to the exact width and height above.

watermarkImage.description: Media attachment ID for the watermark graphic.

watermarkImageDimensionHeight.description: Max height in pixels (0 = automatic). Classic metabox only; takeover uses width with auto height.

watermarkMargin.description: Space from the edge of the image (px).

watermarkApplyToExistingImages.description: UI-only placeholder; Pro applies watermark via AJAX (save gallery first).

watermarkRemoveWatermark.description: UI-only placeholder; Pro removes watermark via AJAX (save gallery first).

items.description: Per-item catalog: modula-images rows (attachment id) plus optional modula_images_v2-only rows with itemKind content_block or shortcode (embeddedId, anchors, block/shortcode fields).

tile_image_fit.description: Custom grid only: contain shows the full photo inside the tile (letterbox); cover fills the tile and may crop.

flatToGroupedMappingNote: Full mapping: Modula\\V2\\Settings\\Field_Registry::get_flat_to_grouped_mapping(). Adapter delegates to Field_Registry.
